note: Explicit decisions for reading thread_templates.json. An empty list means the catalog tag has no engine place kind yet, so it is not used. Pay is spoken only: nothing pays out until a job can be finished. The catalog's offer windows of 2 to 14 hours are scaled so a town does not empty during one walk; tune offer_hours_scale by playing.

serve_the_great.label: güçlü birinin yanında hizmet, koruma, mevki

background_labels.note: Catalog labels to saved character backgrounds. Not used yet: a background hook only applies once an offer exists (roadmap step 4), and then only when the player shows it.

names.note: Which name_pools.json template fits which place kind. A kind not listed keeps 'person name + word'. Inn templates ending in Konağı read as an estate, Misafirhanesi and Konukevi are not found by the word han, and a door or a sleep word in a name would be read as the deed, so those are left out. Templates joined by ile or ve are left out, and lavanta is avoided, because a person's line would be read back as a cut name. place_name_avoid are folded word starts no generated name may contain.

openings.note: How opening_lines.json is read. scene_tags and place_tags turn a location into a catalog tag. Only slots in bound_slots can be filled, with the place's saved name: a city has no saved street name, so a line needing one is left out, never guessed. clear_sky_only lines speak of direct sun or last light and are left out in any other weather. Each line's other details are ambience the narrator voices; nothing in them becomes a saved object.

role_profiles.note: Which npc_roles.json profiles fit an engine role, by folded role name. A person keeps one profile, chosen by campaign seed and person. Only the topic lists reach the speech prompt: they bound what a person can claim and never create a fact. A role with no fitting profile has no entry: Kent sakini, Hamal, Arabacı, Çırak, Arşivci, Kütüphaneci, Fırıncı, Mezarcı and Seyis have none in the catalog, and the street seller gets the one profile that does not clash with a fruit stall.

bound_text.note: Explicit decisions for binding scene_details, written_texts and work_lines to real records. A kind with no entry is simply not served by these catalogs; the older owner answers it.
